Notices for code inside vanilla-picker.js

vanilla-picker.js (vanilla-picker 2.12.3, ISC, see LICENSE.md) has one dependency
compiled in:

  @sphinxxxx/color-conversion 2.2.2 (ISC), by Andreas Borgen (Sphinxxxx), who is also
  an author of vanilla-picker. Its npm tarball ships no licence file; the ISC licence
  is declared in its package.json and is the text in LICENSE.md.
